title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are excited to announce the full launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to provide you with unparalleled insights and enhanced capabilities.

title: Complete File Control in Your Editor
summary: We've launched powerful new capabilities that empower you to easily manage, upload, and customize the display of all your essential files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing the Public Roadmap
summary: We are thrilled to unveil our new public roadmap, offering a clear and dynamic overview of our journey, from what's just been delivered to what's coming soon and beyond.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've rolled out significant improvements to checkboxes, making them larger, easier to click, and seamlessly integrated with our modern design.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Features
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our enhanced collaboration features, designed to make working together effortless and intuitive.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery & Collaboration
summary: Effortlessly discover and interact with items shared by your connections, streamlining collaboration and boosting productivity.

title: Global Language Support Arrives
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out extensive support for international languages, connecting users worldwide.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's core codebase is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in its exciting future.

title: Dynamic Constellation View: Unlock Deeper Insights
summary: Transform your Constellation view into an intelligent exploration tool, enabling powerful filtering by tags, time, and shared items to uncover new connections and insights.

title: Powerful Search and Curation Tools
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your most relevant information with new advanced filters and sorting options, allowing you to save tailored searches for instant access to curated collections.

title: Smarter Note Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive and flexible way to display and interact with your linked content, empowering you to structure your thoughts effortlessly.

title: Noeko: Your Data, Your Control with Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Unlock ultimate control and enhanced capabilities for your data with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting option and flexible premium plans.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Visual Enhancements
summary: Elevate your Noeko experience with a stunning collection of brand new themes and significant improvements to our existing designs, offering a fresh and personalized look for every user.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We've refined our time-sensitive greetings to always display the correct time of day, making your experience even more tailored and welcoming.

title: Powerful In-List Item Management
summary: Gain powerful control over your items with new in-list actions, enabling you to quickly unapply tags, delete items, and more without navigating away.

title: Elevate Your Research with Expanded Source Support
summary: Effortlessly capture and interact with a richer variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to centralize all your essential information directly within the platform.
